facts.fact: Mia 婚礼上穿白纱与樱花装饰的机车靴。
facts.anchor: she wore white, blossom-covered biker boots

facts.fact: Rayenne 说 handfasting 是两人爱情的肉体、精神与魔法体现。
facts.anchor: It is a physical, spiritual and magical manifestation

facts.fact: Lunar 飞来把装戒指的小绒袋丢进 Jamie 手里。
facts.anchor: dropped a small velvet bag into his hand

facts.fact: Mia 在誓言里说 Aiden 让她知道魔法的意义。
facts.anchor: You showed me the meaning of magic

facts.fact: Mia 告诉 Jamie，他们原本延后婚礼的原因之一就是他心碎。
facts.anchor: one of the reasons Aiden and I had planned to delay was you

facts.fact: Jamie 不用回头就知道是 Amrita，因为魔法被牵动。
facts.anchor: the tug in his magic was enough

facts.fact: Jamie 提出他可以离开 Hudsbury、请人封掉天赋。
facts.anchor: I could leave Hudsbury for you

facts.fact: Amrita 说绝不要求他这么做，因为朋友家人与魔法都是他的一部分。
facts.anchor: I would never ask you to do that

facts.fact: 她反过来道歉，为当时崩溃、失约、无视他。
facts.anchor: I’m the one who needs to apologise

facts.fact: 她说已经开始跟 Rayenne 学，愿意试着留在 Hudsbury，和他一起。
facts.anchor: It’s somewhere I’d like to try to be. With you.

facts.fact: 章末 Mist 说这是世界在自我校正，一切正如她所说会成。
facts.anchor: The world realigning to correct itself.
